# Hire & Fire Your Kids

> A gamified chore management platform that transforms household responsibilities into an engaging game to teach kids responsibility, financial literacy, and work ethic.

Hire & Fire Your Kids is a family app based in Whitby, Ontario that combines behavioral science with gamification to help parents manage chores and develop their children's life skills. The platform offers web and mobile access with flexible subscription plans and has gained recognition through media coverage including Dragons' Den.
